speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms are concerning for a systemic illness, possibly malignancy or infection. To narrow this down, can you tell me if you have noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool color?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, ESR, CRP, LDH.

speaker: Measurement
text:

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history; given your smoking history and the "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss), we must rule out lymphoma. REQUEST TEST: LDH and beta-2 microglobulin; have you noticed any lumps under your arms or in your neck?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: LDH - Elevated, beta-2 microglobulin - Not Available
